title: HostFactory getRequestStatus response
$comment: Pins what hf-gke emits today. Spec: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/spectrum-symphony/7.3.2?topic=specification-getrequeststatus. Differences from the spec are noted inline.

requests.$comment: The spec shows a single object. hf-gke answers in the form it was asked: an array for a list of requests, one object for one request.

machines.$comment: The spec shows a single object. hf-gke emits an array.

status.$comment: The spec also lists 'shutting-down' and 'stopping'. hf-gke has no such status.

privateIpAddress.$comment: The spec requires a string. hf-gke emits null while the pod has no IP.

publicIpAddress.$comment: hf-gke always emits an empty string.

launchtime.$comment: The spec requires a number. hf-gke emits an empty string while the pod has no start time. hf-gce uses 'launchTime'. HostFactory accepts either spelling.
